verses.text: Better to be poor and walk with integrity than be a fool whose words are twisted.
All that drive won't do you good without knowledge. Rush ahead too fast and you'll miss the road.
People wreck their own lives by acting foolish, then get furious with the LORD about it.
Money brings a crowd of friends. A poor person can lose the friend they already had.
A false witness will face punishment. Someone who keeps pouring out lies won't walk free.
Plenty of people try to get on a ruler's good side. Everybody wants to be friends with someone who gives out gifts.
Even a poor person's relatives keep their distance. How much more will their friends dodge them! They go after them begging, but those people are gone.
Get wisdom and you're showing love for your own soul. Hold on to understanding and you'll find good things.
A false witness will face punishment. The person who tells lies will perish.
A life of luxury doesn't suit a fool. A servant ruling over princes makes even less sense.
Good judgment slows down your anger. There's honor in letting an offense go.
A king's anger sounds like a lion roaring. His favor is like dew on the grass.
A foolish son is a disaster for his father. A wife's quarrels are like a drip that won't stop.
You can inherit a house and money from your parents. A wife with good judgment comes from the LORD.
Laziness drags you into a deep sleep. Sit around doing nothing and you'll go hungry.
Keep the command and you'll guard your life. Treat the way you live with contempt and you'll die.
Show kindness to someone who's poor and you're lending to the LORD. He'll pay you back.
Discipline your son while there's still hope. Don't go along with anything that leads to his death.
A hothead has to pay for what they did. Bail them out and you'll just have to do it again.
Listen to advice and take correction so you'll have wisdom later in life.
You can have all kinds of plans in your heart. What the LORD decides will stand.
Kindness is what draws people to someone. Better to be poor than a liar.
Standing in awe of the LORD leads to life. You can rest content, with trouble unable to touch you.
A lazy person sticks their hand in the dish and can't even be bothered to bring it back up to their mouth.
Give a mocker a whipping and the gullible will pick up some good sense. Correct someone with understanding and they'll learn from it.
A son who robs his father and drives his mother away brings shame and disgrace.
My son, stop listening to instruction and you'll wander away from words that can teach you.
A corrupt witness laughs at justice. The wicked swallow wrongdoing like they can't get enough.
Punishments are ready for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
